# MURYA - Muryar Zabe | Voice of the Election

> MURYA is a verified civic information platform for Bauchi State, Nigeria. Provides trusted INEC information in Hausa, Fulfulde and English. Features voice reporting, LGA verification, human-approved helpdesk, and citizen engagement for 5.1M voters across 20 LGAs.

## About
- **Name:** MURYA means VOICE in Hausa
- **Purpose:** Connect citizens to verified government services and civic info
- **Languages:** Hausa, Fulfulde, English
- **Coverage:** All 20 LGAs of Bauchi State - Bauchi, Toro, Alkaleri, Misau, Katagum, Jama'are, and 14 more
- **Team:** Bauchi, Bauchi State - Built for AI4Elections Track 3
- **Author:** Zaharaddeen Muhammad

## Features
- Voice Reporting (Hausa Voice Input/Output with gTTS)
- Verified Information from inec.gov.ng (human-approved)
- Voting & Civic Engagement Dashboard (aggregates only, no PII)
- LGA-based verification and search
- Privacy: consent screen, delete button, auto-scrub of phone numbers
- Responsible AI: AI suggests draft, human publishes

## Official Links
- Live Demo: [https://murya-engrdeeno.streamlit.app](https://murya-engrdeeno.streamlit.app)
- GitHub: [https://github.com/zaharaddeenmuhammad-pixel/MURYA](https://github.com/zaharaddeenmuhammad-pixel/MURYA)
- INEC Official: [https://www.inecnigeria.org](https://www.inecnigeria.org)
- Voters Portal: [https://voters.inecnigeria.org](https://voters.inecnigeria.org)

## Technology
- Stack: Python, Streamlit, Supabase Postgres, Sentence Transformers multilingual embeddings
- Security: Phone number auto-scrub (070...), PU code (04-05-03-001), audit log
- Compliance: Nonpartisan, public data only, no live electoral system access, human-in-loop

## Contact
Independent civic-tech project. Not an official INEC product. For verification, visit [inec.gov.ng](https://www.inec.gov.ng).
